What moved her: you committed that the rewrite would replace the zero and leave his record clean, which protected the one thing she never gives up.
What cost ground: you offered the rewrite before showing anything, so to her it looked like a punishment with no reason behind it.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your case never came near that night because you showed no evidence at all; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: when she opens by asking who decided and whether Owen was asked first, answer that directly, own that the zero went in before anyone called her, and show one dated piece of evidence tied to Owen's own work before you mention a rewrite.
